note: The file tool of langchain-anthropic's text-editor and memory middleware puts `path`, and the arguments the call passes, in an `args` dict and hands it to the handler of the command; `_handle_rename` reads `args["old_path"]`, a key the tool never sets, so every rename fails with a KeyError, in the state-backed and in the filesystem-backed middleware. The module builds an agent with each pair of middleware.

fixed.fix_note: langchain-anthropic 1.5.5 puts the path under `old_path` as well.
